multi_entity_note: Two parties: Erchonia Corporation (supplier) and InnerScope Hearing Technologies Inc (distributor), each with its own address.
processing_note: Erchonia shall submit invoices to Distributor after or concurrent with shipment of Products to Distributor at the delivery address.

contract.document_name.rationale: The title line names the agreement 'ERCHONIA CORPORATION EXCLUSIVE DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT'; the bare 'EXCLUSIVE DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT' is part of it.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The 'Dated:' line is blank; 11/9/2018 is only the SEC filing date in page footers and 8/29/2018 is a revision stamp.

contract.effective_date.rationale: No effective date is stated; the dates present are filing-footer and revision-stamp dates.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The initial term is given only as a duration of three (3) years, never as a date.

contract.governing_law.value: the laws of the United States and the State of Florida
contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 12(e) chooses the laws of the United States and the State of Florida; 'State of Florida' alone is part of that value.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Section 6(a) says the agreement automatically renews for a period of three (3) years; the first 'three (3) years' is the initial term.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No notice period for preventing renewal is stated; the listed periods concern price changes, payment, cure and dismissal.
